steps.name: demo-teams-script
steps.summary: Added scripts/setup_demo_teams.py (idempotent, direct-pool seeding via gateway.db, four fixed-id demo teams: demo-realtime-highvolume, demo-batch-lowpriority, demo-tight-budget, demo-frontier, allowed_models drawn from config.yaml with claude-sonnet/claude-opus listed first per ADR-008) writing scripts/demo_teams.json (list of {team_id, name, api_key, rpm_limit, tpm_limit, daily_budget_usd, monthly_budget_usd, allowed_models}, gitignored); added the `setup` one-shot service to deploy/docker-compose.yml and `COPY scripts ./scripts` to the Dockerfile.

steps.name: integration-ratelimit-budget
steps.summary: Added tests/integration/test_concurrent_ratelimit_budget.py (local client fixture + _insert_team/_delete_team helpers, small test-specific limits, no reuse of seeded_team): exact-count asyncio.gather assertions for rpm (10/30 admitted), tpm (3/10 admitted via explicit max_tokens sizing), and streaming (5/15 admitted) dimensions in isolation; budget test asserts only eventual consistency -- first wave's 200/402 split unasserted, second wave (post-settle) uniformly 402 once tracked spend exceeds a $0.00001 cap sized to guarantee crossing within 5 requests regardless of race outcome.

steps.name: integration-resilience
steps.summary: Added tests/integration/test_concurrent_resilience.py (local client fixture, _insert_team/_delete_team helpers, anthropic_breaker fixture resetting the shared anthropic breaker's Redis keys + circuit_breaker_history rows before/after each test) covering concurrent fallback activation (10x claude-sonnet--fault-error all served 200/gpt-4o-mini), concurrent circuit-breaker open->half_open->open under real HTTP traffic (asserts closed->open history row after 10 concurrent failures, no new row while open, then open->half_open and half_open->open rows after a real 30s cooldown sleep), and concurrent streaming integrity (10 concurrent gpt-4o-mini/claude-sonnet streams with distinctive per-request prompts, reusing test_streaming.py's _read_sse/_assemble_content, asserting no cross-request model/content leakage); edited tests/fixtures/test_config.yaml adding claude-sonnet--fault-error to providers.anthropic.models and prepending [anthropic:claude-sonnet--fault-error, openai:gpt-4o-mini] ahead of the existing 3-entry fast_tier block (rather than appending after it as originally sketched) since resolve_fallback_chain() returns everything after a target's first occurrence in the flat list -- appending after ollama:llama3 would have broken its 'resolves to []' invariant and swept the new entries into anthropic:claude-sonnet's own chain, breaking test_fallback.py and test_orchestrator.py; the original 3-entry block is preserved fully intact and unreordered as a contiguous suffix, so every pre-existing lookup is unaffected. Full suite (225 tests) passes.
